276	class LookupKeyServer:
277	    def __init__(
278	        self,
279	        pool_worker: KVPoolWorker,
280	        vllm_config: "VllmConfig",
281	    ):
282	        self.decoder = MsgpackDecoder()
283	        self.ctx = zmq.Context()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
284	        socket_path = get_zmq_rpc_path_lookup(vllm_config)
285	        self.socket = make_zmq_socket(
286	            self.ctx,
287	            socket_path,
288	            zmq.REP,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
289	            bind=True,
290	        )
291	
292	        self.pool_worker = pool_worker
293	        self.running = True
294	
295	        def process_request():
296	            while self.running:
297	                all_frames = self.socket.recv_multipart(copy=False)
298	                token_len = int.from_bytes(all_frames[0], byteorder="big")
299	                kv_group_ids = self.decoder.decode([all_frames[1]])
300	                hash_frames = all_frames[2:]
301	                hashes_str = self.decoder.decode(hash_frames)
302	                result = self.pool_worker.lookup_scheduler(
303	                    token_len,
304	                    hashes_str,
305	                    kv_group_ids,
306	                    use_layerwise=False,
307	                )
308	                logger.debug(
309	                    "KV pool lookup response token_len=%d groups=%s hit_tokens=%d",
310	                    token_len,
311	                    kv_group_ids,
312	                    result,
313	                )
314	                response = result.to_bytes(4, "big")
315	                self.socket.send(response)
316	
317	        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=process_request, daemon=True)
318	        self.thread.start()
319	
320	    def close(self):
321	        self.socket.close(linger=0)

143	def _get_layer_compress_ratio(
144	    layer_name: str,
145	    compress_ratios: Sequence[int] | None,
146	    hf_config: Any | None = None,
147	) -> int | None:
148	    if compress_ratios is None:
149	        return None
150	    if getattr(hf_config, "model_type", None) == "deepseek_v4":
151	        from vllm_ascend.utils import extract_dsv4_layer_index, get_dsv4_compress_ratio
152	
153	        return get_dsv4_compress_ratio(hf_config, extract_dsv4_layer_index(hf_config, layer_name))
154	    from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index

159	def _get_group_spec_ratios(group: object) -> set[int | None]:
160	    kv_cache_spec = getattr(group, "kv_cache_spec", None)
161	    if kv_cache_spec is None:
162	        return set()
163	    kv_cache_specs = getattr(kv_cache_spec, "kv_cache_specs", None)
164	    if kv_cache_specs is not None:
165	        return {getattr(spec, "compress_ratio", None) for spec in kv_cache_specs.values()}
166	    return {getattr(kv_cache_spec, "compress_ratio", None)}

168	
169	def infer_group_cache_families(
170	    kv_cache_groups: Sequence[object] | None,
171	    compress_ratios: Sequence[int] | None,
172	    hf_config: Any | None = None,
173	) -> list[str]:
174	    if kv_cache_groups is None:
175	        return ["default"]
176	
177	    families: list[str] = []
178	    for group in kv_cache_groups:
179	        spec_ratios = _get_group_spec_ratios(group)
180	        if len(spec_ratios) == 1:
181	            families.append(infer_cache_family_from_ratio(next(iter(spec_ratios))))
182	            continue
183	        if len(spec_ratios) > 1:
184	            families.append("mixed")
185	            continue
186	
187	        layer_names = list(getattr(group, "layer_names", []))
188	        if compress_ratios is None or not layer_names:
189	            families.append("default")
190	            continue
191	
192	        group_ratios = {_get_layer_compress_ratio(layer_name, compress_ratios, hf_config) for layer_name in layer_names}
193	        if len(group_ratios) == 1:
194	            families.append(infer_cache_family_from_ratio(next(iter(group_ratios))))
195	        else:
196	            logger.debug(
197	                "KV cache group has mixed layer compress ratios %s for layers %s; using mixed cache family.",
198	                sorted(group_ratios, key=lambda ratio: -1 if ratio is None else ratio),
199	                layer_names,
200	            )
201	            families.append("mixed")
202	    return families

370	        group_block_size = self.get_block_size(0)
371	        block_idx = start // group_block_size
372	        if block_idx >= len(block_ids):
373	            return [], [], 0
374	        block_id = block_ids[block_idx]
375	        addr_list: list[int] = []
376	        size_list: list[int] = []
377	        group_addrs, group_block_len, group_block_stride = self._get_group_buffers(0)
378	        num_layers = self.group_num_layers.get("kv", {}).get(0, 1)
379	        entries_per_layer = len(group_addrs) // num_layers if num_layers else 0
380	        if layer_id >= num_layers or entries_per_layer == 0:
381	            return [], [], 0
382	        start_idx = layer_id * entries_per_layer
383	        for i in range(entries_per_layer):
384	            idx = start_idx + i
385	            block_stride = group_block_stride[idx] if group_block_stride else group_block_len[idx]
386	            addr = group_addrs[idx] + block_id * block_stride
387	            size = int(group_block_len[idx] / group_block_size * (end - start))
388	            addr_list.append(addr)
389	            size_list.append(size)
390	        return addr_list, size_list, block_id

392	    def process_tokens(
393	        self,
394	        token_len: int,
395	        block_hashes: BlockHashList | list[str],
396	        mask_num: int = 0,
397	        kv_cache_group_id: int = 0,
398	        cache_role: str = "kv",
399	        cache_family: str | None = None,
400	    ) -> Iterable[tuple[int, int, PoolKey]]:
401	        """Process the tokens and return the corresponding cache engine keys."""
402	        if not block_hashes:
403	            return
404	        group_block_size = self.get_block_size(kv_cache_group_id)
405	        if cache_family is None:
406	            cache_family = self.group_cache_families.get(cache_role, {}).get(kv_cache_group_id, "default")
407	        cache_family_ratio = max(infer_cache_family_ratio(cache_family), 1)
408	        group_block_size *= cache_family_ratio
409	        block_hashes = get_block_hashes(
410	            block_hashes,
411	            group_block_size,
412	            self.hash_block_size,
413	        )
414	        if not block_hashes:
415	            return
416	        if not isinstance(block_hashes[0], str):
417	            block_hashes = [
418	                h.hex() if not isinstance(h, str) else h  # type: ignore[union-attr]
419	                for h in block_hashes
420	            ]
421	        start_idx = 0
422	        for chunk_id, hash_val in enumerate(block_hashes):
423	            start_idx = chunk_id * group_block_size
424	            if start_idx >= token_len:
425	                break
426	            end_idx = min(start_idx + group_block_size, token_len)
427	            if start_idx < mask_num:
428	                continue
429	            else:
430	                start_idx //= cache_family_ratio
431	                end_idx //= cache_family_ratio
432	                if end_idx <= start_idx:
433	                    continue
434	                yield (
435	                    start_idx,
436	                    end_idx,
437	                    self._make_key_by_hash(
438	                        hash_val,
439	                        kv_cache_group_id=kv_cache_group_id,
440	                        cache_role=cache_role,
441	                        cache_family=cache_family,
442	                    ),
443	                )

445	    def process_tokens_with_block_ids(
446	        self,
447	        token_len: int,
448	        block_hashes: BlockHashList | list[str],
449	        block_ids: list[int],
450	        mask_num: int = 0,
451	        kv_cache_group_id: int = 0,
452	        skip_null_blocks: bool = False,
453	        cache_role: str = "kv",
454	        cache_family: str | None = None,
455	    ) -> Iterable[tuple[int, int, PoolKey, int]]:
456	        all_chunks = list(
457	            self.process_tokens(
458	                token_len,
459	                block_hashes,
460	                0,
461	                kv_cache_group_id=kv_cache_group_id,
462	                cache_role=cache_role,
463	                cache_family=cache_family,
464	            )
465	        )
466	        if not all_chunks:
467	            return
468	
469	        group_block_size = self.get_block_size(kv_cache_group_id)
470	        # Sliding-window groups can expose only live tail block ids while keys
471	        # still use logical chunk positions from the full prefix.
472	        num_logical_blocks = all_chunks[-1][0] // group_block_size + 1
473	        block_id_offset = max(num_logical_blocks - len(block_ids), 0)
474	        chunks = all_chunks
475	        if mask_num:
476	            chunks = list(
477	                self.process_tokens(
478	                    token_len,
479	                    block_hashes,
480	                    mask_num,
481	                    kv_cache_group_id=kv_cache_group_id,
482	                    cache_role=cache_role,
483	                    cache_family=cache_family,
484	                )
485	            )
486	
487	        for start_idx, end_idx, key in chunks:
488	            block_idx = start_idx // group_block_size - block_id_offset
489	            if block_idx < 0 or block_idx >= len(block_ids):
490	                continue
491	            block_id = block_ids[block_idx]
492	            if skip_null_blocks and block_id <= 0:
493	                continue
494	            yield start_idx, end_idx, key, block_id
495	
496	    def decode_adaptor_prefill_pp(self, key, addr, size, kv_cache_group_id: int = 0, cache_role: str = "kv"):
497	        if self.partitions is None or len(self.partitions) == 1:
498	            return key, addr, size
499	
500	        new_key = []
501	        new_addr = []
502	        new_size = []
503	
504	        group_num_layers = self.group_num_layers.get(cache_role, {}).get(kv_cache_group_id, 0)
505	        for i, (addr_list, size_list) in enumerate(zip(addr, size)):
506	            caches_per_layer = len(addr_list) // group_num_layers if group_num_layers else 2
507	            caches_per_layer = max(caches_per_layer, 1)
508	            start = 0
509	            for j, part in enumerate(self.partitions):
510	                end = len(addr_list) if j == len(self.partitions) - 1 else start + part * caches_per_layer
511	                new_str = key[i].replace(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
512	                    "@pp_rank:0", f"@pp_rank:{j}", 1
513	                )
514	                new_key.append(new_str)
515	                new_addr.append(addr_list[start:end])
516	                new_size.append(size_list[start:end])
517	                start = end
518	        return new_key, new_addr, new_size

521	def normalize_block_ids_by_group(block_ids: tuple[list[int], ...] | list[int] | list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
522	    if isinstance(block_ids, tuple):
523	        return [group.copy() for group in block_ids]
524	    if isinstance(block_ids, list):
525	        if not block_ids:
526	            return [[]]
527	        if isinstance(block_ids[0], list):
528	            grouped_block_ids = cast(list[list[int]], block_ids)
529	            return [group.copy() for group in grouped_block_ids]
530	        flat_block_ids = cast(list[int], block_ids)
531	        return [flat_block_ids.copy()]
532	    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported block_ids type {type(block_ids)}")
533	
534	
535	def get_block_hashes(
536	    block_hashes: BlockHashList | list[str],
537	    group_block_size: int,
538	    hash_block_size: int,
539	) -> BlockHashList | list[str]:
540	    if group_block_size == hash_block_size:
541	        return block_hashes
542	    assert group_block_size % hash_block_size == 0, "block_size must be divisible by hash_block_size"
543	    scale_factor = group_block_size // hash_block_size
544	    return [
545	        _rehash_block_hash_group(block_hashes[idx : idx + scale_factor])
546	        for idx in range(0, len(block_hashes) // scale_factor * scale_factor, scale_factor)
547	    ]
548	
549	
550	def _rehash_block_hash_group(block_hashes: Sequence[BlockHash | str]) -> BlockHash:
551	    hasher = hashlib.sha256()
552	    hasher.update(_GROUPED_BLOCK_HASH_DOMAIN)
553	    hasher.update(len(block_hashes).to_bytes(_GROUPED_BLOCK_HASH_LENGTH_PREFIX_BYTES, "big"))
554	    for block_hash in block_hashes:
555	        hash_bytes = _block_hash_to_bytes(block_hash)
556	        hasher.update(len(hash_bytes).to_bytes(_GROUPED_BLOCK_HASH_LENGTH_PREFIX_BYTES, "big"))
557	        hasher.update(hash_bytes)
558	    return BlockHash(hasher.digest())
559	
560	
561	def _block_hash_to_bytes(block_hash: BlockHash | str) -> bytes:
562	    if isinstance(block_hash, str):
563	        if len(block_hash) == 64:
564	            try:
565	                return bytes.fromhex(block_hash)
566	            except ValueError:
567	                return block_hash.encode("utf-8")
568	        return block_hash.encode("utf-8")
569	    return bytes(block_hash)

694	        num_computed_tokens: int = 0,
695	    ) -> None:
696	        """Update the request tracker when a running request is scheduled again."""
697	        normalized = normalize_block_ids_by_group(new_block_ids)
698	        if len(normalized) > len(self.allocated_block_ids_by_group):
699	            self.allocated_block_ids_by_group.extend(
700	                [[] for _ in range(len(normalized) - len(self.allocated_block_ids_by_group))]
701	            )
702	        for group_id, ids in enumerate(normalized):
703	            self.update_mamba_spec_blocks(ids, group_id, num_computed_tokens)
704	            self.allocated_block_ids_by_group[group_id].extend(ids)

706	    def update_mamba_spec_blocks(self, block_ids: list[int], kv_cache_group_id: int, num_computed_tokens: int):
707	        """
708	        for mamba align groups, each step will:
709	            - Firstly, remove some previous blocks and append some necessary null blocks
710	            - Secondly, move the speculative blocks(maybe all or partially) to the last position for reuse
711	            - Finally, allocate a new block
712	        so, if a speculative block is moved to last position and replaced with null block,
713	        we also need to update the previous allocated_block_ids to 0.
714	        """
715	        if self.mamba_group_ids and kv_cache_group_id in self.mamba_group_ids:
716	            assert self.block_sizes is not None and len(self.block_sizes) > kv_cache_group_id
717	            num_skipped_blocks = (
718	                max(num_computed_tokens - self.num_speculative_blocks - 1, 0) // self.block_sizes[kv_cache_group_id]
719	            )
720	            num_skipped_blocks = min(len(self.allocated_block_ids_by_group[kv_cache_group_id]), num_skipped_blocks)
721	            if num_skipped_blocks > 0:
722	                self.allocated_block_ids_by_group[kv_cache_group_id][:num_skipped_blocks] = [0] * num_skipped_blocks
723	            if not block_ids or self.num_speculative_blocks <= 0:
724	                return
725	            mask_spec_count = min(len(block_ids) - 1, self.num_speculative_blocks)
726	            group_block_ids = self.allocated_block_ids_by_group[kv_cache_group_id]
727	            if mask_spec_count >= self.num_speculative_blocks:
728	                group_block_ids[-self.num_speculative_blocks :] = [0] * self.num_speculative_blocks
729	            else:
730	                group_block_ids[-self.num_speculative_blocks : mask_spec_count - self.num_speculative_blocks] = [
731	                    0
732	                ] * mask_spec_count

868	            block_hashes = []
869	        target_token_len = tracker.token_len
870	        previous_saved_tokens = tracker.num_saved_tokens
871	
872	        # For save operation: do not save if the following condition is met
873	        # 1. has already been saved before (num_saved_tokens > 0)
874	        # 2. number of unsaved tokens is not reached the chunk boundary
875	        chunk_boundary = (
876	            cdiv(tracker.num_saved_tokens + 1, cache_transfer_granularity) * cache_transfer_granularity
877	            if discard_partial_chunks
878	            else 0
879	        )
880	        num_tokens_to_save = (
881	            (target_token_len // cache_transfer_granularity * cache_transfer_granularity)
882	            if discard_partial_chunks

282	    def _generate_store_query_keys(
283	        self,
284	        block_hashes,
285	        include_layers: bool = False,
286	        kv_cache_group_id: int = 0,
287	    ) -> list[list[str]]:
288	        head_or_tp_ranks = self.tp_size // self.put_step
289	        cache_family = self._get_group_family(self.kv_cache_group_families, kv_cache_group_id)
290	        keys_by_block = []
291	        for block_hash in block_hashes:
292	            block_keys: list[str] = []
293	            chunk_hash = block_hash if isinstance(block_hash, str) else block_hash.hex()
294	            pp_ranks = [self.pp_rank] if include_layers else range(self.pp_size)
295	            for pcp_rank in range(self.pcp_size):
296	                for dcp_rank in range(self.dcp_size):
297	                    for head_or_tp_rank in range(head_or_tp_ranks):
298	                        for pp_rank in pp_ranks:
299	                            pool_key = PoolKey(
300	                                KeyMetadata(
301	                                    self.model_name,
302	                                    head_or_tp_rank,
303	                                    pcp_rank,
304	                                    dcp_rank,
305	                                    pp_rank,
306	                                    kv_cache_group_id=kv_cache_group_id,
307	                                    cache_family=cache_family,
308	                                ),
309	                                chunk_hash,
310	                            )
311	                            if include_layers:
312	                                block_keys.extend(
313	                                    layer_key.to_string() for layer_key in pool_key.split_layers(self.num_layers)
314	                                )
315	                            else:
316	                                block_keys.append(pool_key.to_string())
317	            keys_by_block.append(block_keys)
318	        return keys_by_block

320	    def _get_store_lookup_hit_tokens(
321	        self,
322	        request: "Request",
323	        token_len: int,
324	        num_computed_tokens: int,
325	        include_layers: bool = False,
326	    ) -> int:
327	        num_blocks = token_len // self._block_size
328	        # In layerwise mode, always query from block 0 because the remote
329	        # pool stores per-layer data that may not match local prefix cache.
330	        query_start_block = 0 if self.use_layerwise else min(num_computed_tokens // self._block_size, num_blocks)
331	        block_hashes_to_query = request.block_hashes[query_start_block:num_blocks]
332	        if not block_hashes_to_query:
333	            return 0
334	
335	        query_keys_by_block = self._generate_store_query_keys(
336	            block_hashes_to_query,
337	            include_layers=include_layers,
338	        )
339	        query_keys = [key for block_keys in query_keys_by_block for key in block_keys]
340	        exists_states = self.store_scheduler.batch_is_exist(query_keys)
341	        if len(exists_states) != len(query_keys):
342	            raise RuntimeError(
343	                "KV pool exists check returned unexpected number of "
344	                f"states for request {request.request_id}: "
345	                f"expected={len(query_keys)}, actual={len(exists_states)}"
346	            )
347	
348	        num_queried_hit_blocks = 0
349	        offset = 0
350	        for block_keys in query_keys_by_block:
351	            block_states = exists_states[offset : offset + len(block_keys)]
352	            offset += len(block_keys)
353	            if all(exists == 1 for exists in block_states):
354	                num_queried_hit_blocks += 1
355	                continue
356	            if any(exists == 0 for exists in block_states):
357	                break
358	            raise RuntimeError(f"KV pool exists check failed for request {request.request_id}: states={exists_states}")
359	
360	        num_hit_blocks = query_start_block + num_queried_hit_blocks
361	        return num_hit_blocks * self._block_size
362	
363	    def _get_layerwise_gva_hit_tokens(
364	        self,
365	        request: "Request",
366	        token_len: int,
367	        num_computed_tokens: int,
368	    ) -> int:
369	        num_blocks = token_len // self._block_size
370	        num_queried_hit_blocks = 0
371	        block_hashes_to_check = request.block_hashes[:num_blocks]
372	        keys_to_check = [f"{self.model_name}@{bh.hex()}" for bh in block_hashes_to_check]
373	        # In layerwise mode, always query from block 0 because the remote
374	        # pool stores per-layer data that may not match local prefix cache.
375	        query_start_block = 0 if self.use_layerwise else min(num_computed_tokens // self._block_size, num_blocks)
376	        keys_to_query = keys_to_check[query_start_block:]
377	        if not keys_to_query:
378	            return 0
379	        tracker = self._get_or_create_request_tracker(request.request_id)
380	        cached_gvas = []
381	        key_infos = self.store_scheduler.batch_get_key_info(keys_to_query)
382	        for key_info in key_infos:
383	            sizes = key_info.size()
384	            if sizes and sizes > 0:
385	                cached_gvas.append(key_info.gva_list()[0])
386	                num_queried_hit_blocks += 1
387	            else:
388	                break
389	        num_hit_blocks = query_start_block + num_queried_hit_blocks
390	        tracker.block_keys = keys_to_check[query_start_block:num_hit_blocks]
391	        tracker.block_gvas = cached_gvas[:num_queried_hit_blocks]
392	        tracker.gva_block_offset = query_start_block
393	        return num_hit_blocks * self._block_size

461	    def _infer_swa_blocks(self) -> list[int]:
462	        if self.kv_cache_config is None:
463	            return []
464	
465	        num_swa_blocks: list[int] = []
466	        for group in self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups:
467	            kv_cache_spec = group.kv_cache_spec
468	            if isinstance(kv_cache_spec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs):
469	                group_specs = []
470	                for layer_name in group.layer_names:
471	                    layer_spec = kv_cache_spec.kv_cache_specs[layer_name]
472	                    if layer_spec not in group_specs:
473	                        group_specs.append(layer_spec)
474	            else:
475	                group_specs = [kv_cache_spec]
476	
477	            first_spec = group_specs[0]
478	            if isinstance(first_spec, SlidingWindowSpec):
479	                num_swa_blocks.append(cdiv(first_spec.sliding_window, first_spec.block_size) + 1)
480	            else:
481	                num_swa_blocks.append(0)
482	            if any(isinstance(spec, MambaSpec) for spec in group_specs):
483	                self.need_truncate = True
484	        return num_swa_blocks

499	    def get_num_new_matched_tokens(
500	        self,
501	        request: "Request",
502	        num_computed_tokens: int,
503	    ) -> tuple[int, bool]:
504	        """
505	        Check for external KV cache hit.
506	
507	        Args:
508	            request (Request): the request object.
509	            num_computed_tokens (int): the number of locally
510	                computed tokens for this request
511	
512	        Returns:
513	            the number of tokens that can be loaded from the
514	            external KV cache beyond what is already computed.
515	        """
516	        if self.kv_role == "kv_consumer" and not self.consumer_is_to_load:
517	            return 0, False
518	
519	        if self._discard_partial_chunks:
520	            token_len = self._floor_to_cache_transfer_granularity(len(request.prompt_token_ids))
521	        else:
522	            token_len = len(request.prompt_token_ids)
523	
524	        if token_len < self.cache_transfer_granularity:
525	            return 0, False
526	
527	        if self.use_gva_layerwise:
528	            num_external_hit_tokens = self._get_layerwise_gva_hit_tokens(request, token_len, num_computed_tokens)
529	        elif self.use_layerwise:
530	            num_external_hit_tokens = self._get_store_lookup_hit_tokens(
531	                request, token_len, num_computed_tokens, include_layers=True
532	            )
533	        else:
534	            if self.client is None:
535	                self.client = LookupKeyClient(self.vllm_config)
536	            num_external_hit_tokens = self.client.lookup(
537	                token_len,
538	                request.block_hashes,
539	                self.kv_cache_group_ids,
540	            )
541	
542	        if num_external_hit_tokens == 0:
543	            return 0, False
544	
545	        if num_external_hit_tokens == request.num_tokens:
546	            num_external_hit_tokens -= 1
547	
548	        if num_external_hit_tokens < num_computed_tokens:
549	            need_to_allocate = 0
550	        else:
551	            need_to_allocate = num_external_hit_tokens - num_computed_tokens
552	
553	        logger.info(
554	            "Reqid: %s, Total tokens %d, kvpool hit tokens: %d, need to load: %d",
555	            request.request_id,
556	            request.num_tokens,
557	            num_external_hit_tokens,
558	            need_to_allocate,
559	        )
560	
561	        # In layerwise mode, even when vLLM has local cached tokens, we still
562	        # need to load KV cache from the pool because layerwise transfer loads
563	        # per-layer data that may not be in HBM.
564	        force_layerwise_load = self.use_layerwise and num_external_hit_tokens > 0
565	        if need_to_allocate <= 0 and not force_layerwise_load:
566	            return 0, False
567	
568	        self.load_specs[request.request_id] = LoadSpec(
569	            vllm_cached_tokens=num_computed_tokens,
570	            kvpool_cached_tokens=num_external_hit_tokens,
571	            can_load=force_layerwise_load,
572	        )
573	        logger.info(
574	            "KV pool load spec created req=%s vllm_cached=%d kvpool_cached=%d "
575	            "need_to_allocate=%d load_async=%s use_layerwise=%s",
576	            request.request_id,
577	            num_computed_tokens,
578	            num_external_hit_tokens,
579	            need_to_allocate,
580	            self.load_async,
581	            self.use_layerwise,
582	        )
583	
584	        return need_to_allocate, self.load_async and not self.use_layerwise
585	
586	    def update_state_after_alloc(self, request: "Request", blocks: "KVCacheBlocks", num_external_tokens: int):
587	        """
588	        Update KVConnector state after temporary buffer alloc.
589	
590	        For SharedStorageConnector, update _request_needs_load
591	        if the CacheManager this allocated blocks for us.
592	        """
593	        local_block_ids: list[list[int]] = [[] for _ in self.kv_cache_group_ids]
594	        if num_external_tokens > 0:
595	            local_block_ids = normalize_block_ids_by_group(blocks.get_block_ids())
596	
597	        self._unfinished_requests[request.request_id] = (request, local_block_ids)
598	        self._unfinished_request_ids.add(request.request_id)
599	        if request.request_id not in self.load_specs:
600	            # No KV tokens from external KV cache, return
601	            logger.debug(
602	                "KV pool update_state_after_alloc req=%s has no load spec; num_external_tokens=%d",
603	                request.request_id,
604	                num_external_tokens,
605	            )
606	            return
607	
608	        if num_external_tokens == 0:
609	            # No need to load anything
610	            self.load_specs[request.request_id].can_load = (
611	                self.use_layerwise and self.load_specs[request.request_id].kvpool_cached_tokens > 0
612	            )
613	            logger.debug(
614	                "KV pool load spec updated req=%s because num_external_tokens=0 "
615	                "can_load=%s vllm_cached=%d kvpool_cached=%d",
616	                request.request_id,
617	                self.load_specs[request.request_id].can_load,
618	                self.load_specs[request.request_id].vllm_cached_tokens,
619	                self.load_specs[request.request_id].kvpool_cached_tokens,
620	            )
621	            return
622	
623	        assert (
624	            num_external_tokens > 0
625	            and num_external_tokens
626	            == self.load_specs[request.request_id].kvpool_cached_tokens
627	            - self.load_specs[request.request_id].vllm_cached_tokens
628	        ), (
629	            f"Mismatch in number of tokens: {num_external_tokens} vs "
630	            f"{self.load_specs[request.request_id].kvpool_cached_tokens} - "
631	            f"{self.load_specs[request.request_id].vllm_cached_tokens}"
632	            f" for request {request.request_id}"
633	        )
634	
635	        self.load_specs[request.request_id].can_load = True
636	        if self.load_async and not self.use_layerwise:
637	            self._loading_req_ids.add(request.request_id)
638	        logger.debug(
639	            "KV pool load spec enabled req=%s num_external_tokens=%d vllm_cached=%d kvpool_cached=%d groups=%s",
640	            request.request_id,
641	            num_external_tokens,
642	            self.load_specs[request.request_id].vllm_cached_tokens,
643	            self.load_specs[request.request_id].kvpool_cached_tokens,
644	            [len(blocks) for blocks in local_block_ids],
645	        )

694	        self,
695	        request: Request,
696	        scheduler_output: SchedulerOutput,
697	        force_skip_save: bool,
698	    ) -> ReqMeta | None:
699	        load_spec = self.load_specs.pop(request.req_id, None)
700	        num_tokens_to_compute = request.num_computed_tokens + scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[request.req_id]
701	        request_tuple = self._unfinished_requests.get(request.req_id)
702	        if request_tuple is None:
703	            raise ValueError(
704	                f"Request {request.req_id} is not in _unfinished_requests, but it is scheduled as a new request"
705	            )
706	        request_real = request_tuple[0]
707	        block_ids_by_group = normalize_block_ids_by_group(request.block_ids)
708	        previous_tracker = self._request_trackers.get(request.req_id)
709	        request_tracker = RequestTracker(
710	            req_id=request.req_id,
711	            token_len=num_tokens_to_compute,
712	            allocated_block_ids_by_group=block_ids_by_group,
713	            num_saved_tokens=0,
714	            token_ids=request.prompt_token_ids[:num_tokens_to_compute].copy(),
715	            num_prompt_tokens=len(request.prompt_token_ids),
716	            block_keys=(previous_tracker.block_keys.copy() if previous_tracker else []),
717	            block_gvas=(previous_tracker.block_gvas.copy() if previous_tracker else []),
718	            gva_block_offset=(previous_tracker.gva_block_offset if previous_tracker else 0),
719	        )
720	        self._request_trackers[request.req_id] = request_tracker
721	        num_blocks = num_tokens_to_compute // self._block_size
722	        has_last_block = num_tokens_to_compute % self._block_size != 0
723	        self._allocate_gva_if_needed(
724	            request_tracker,
725	            request_real.block_hashes,
726	            num_blocks,
727	            has_last_block,
728	        )
729	        return self._build_req_meta(
730	            request_tracker,
731	            request_real.block_hashes,
732	            load_spec,
733	            request.prompt_token_ids,
734	            force_skip_save,
735	        )
